2120979377567773090.en_summary: Renaissance Technologies cut its Nvidia $NVDA stake by 99.7% in Q3, from 7.09M shares worth about $1.4B to just 23,170 shares. It also disclosed a new $620M position in SpaceX $SPCX.
2120979377567773090.zh_summary: Renaissance Technologies在第三季將其Nvidia $NVDA 持股削減了99.7%，從709萬股約值14億美元減少到僅23,170股。它還披露了在SpaceX $SPCX 的新6.2億美元倉位。

2120979236403945538.en_summary: He built NVIDIA over 30 years ago. Can he really walk away? Jensen Huang has led $NVDA since 1993, helping transform it into an AI powerhouse. But after more than three decades at the helm, can NVIDIA thrive without the man who built it? Marty and @IlyaSpivak weigh in.
2120979236403945538.zh_summary: 他30多年前建立了NVIDIA。他真的能離開嗎？Jensen Huang自1993年以來領導 $NVDA，幫助將其轉變為AI巨頭。但在掌舵超過三十年後，沒有建立它的人，NVIDIA能繁榮嗎？Marty和 @IlyaSpivak 權衡。

2120978626132738178.en_summary: BREAKING: SpaceX $SPCX and Tesla $TSLA could merge as soon as December in what would be the largest merger of all time, per Bloomberg. The companies’ boards and advisors are now reportedly hammering out the terms of the agreement.
2120978626132738178.zh_summary: 突發：根據彭博社，SpaceX $SPCX 和 Tesla $TSLA 可能最早在12月合併，這將是有史以來最大的合併。公司董事會和顧問據報正在敲定協議條款。

2120978497430859794.en_summary: There are a lot more questions than answers right now for $NVDA and the industry in general. Here's our team's take on it all in our latest @CarsonGroupLLC blog.
